title: corydalis aurea subsp. occidentalis

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including pain relief, inflammation reduction, and improvement of mood. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of C. aurea subsp. occidentalis on human health, but it has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including anxiety and insomnia.
